UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE CONSOLIDATED STATEMENT OF PROCEDURAL IRREGULARITIES AND JUDICIAL ACTIONS

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine moves for leave to file the document attached as Exhibit A, titled Plaintiff’s Consolidated Statement of Procedural Irregularities and Judicial Actions. In support, Plaintiff states:

1.	Exhibit A places the orders of the Court, the entries of the Clerk, the submissions those orders addressed, and the dispositions that followed in one chronology. It runs through October 30, 2026, the date ECF No. 108 was entered. For each judicial action it identifies the governing rule, states what the rule provides, and states the procedural consequence. It requests no relief.

2.	Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1) provides that no further briefs or written communications may be filed without first obtaining leave of Court. Exhibit A is not a brief on any pending motion. Plaintiff seeks leave rather than file it without leave.

3.	Exhibit A supports matters pending before the District Judge: the Rule 72(a) objections at ECF Nos. 66, 89, and 97 and the motions at ECF Nos. 67, 90, 93, and 98. It also supports the motions under Rule 54(b) and Rule 60(a) directed to ECF Nos. 96 and 108, which are presented to the Magistrate Judge. Rule 72(a) provides that a party may not assign as error a defect in an order not timely objected to. Exhibit A collects, in one document, the orders to which objections have been filed and the rule each objection invokes.

4.	Exhibit A consolidates judicial actions, the governing procedural requirements, and discrepancies between the Court’s descriptions of filings and the contents of those filings. It adds no ground to any pending Rule 72(a) objection or other motion and renews no argument. It requests no modification of ECF No. 12, requires no response from any Defendant, and affects no deadline.

5.	A declaration under 28 U.S.C. § 1746 authenticating Exhibit A accompanies this motion. A memorandum in support and a proposed order are filed with it.

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff requests that the Court grant leave to file Exhibit A and direct the Clerk to docket it as a separate entry.

Date: November 1, 2026		                      Respectfully submitted,

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se
